method: Expansion of rehabilitation outcome pathways into upper-limb function, symptom interference, pediatric participation, cognitive-communication function and prosthetic function. Measures are referenced, not reproduced, when licensing, translation or distribution rights are restricted.
rights_note: HealthMeasures instruments and translations, PEDI-CAT, AMP and commercial dexterity tools are not republished or translated here. Rawafid links to authoritative access/licensing sources and uses original Arabic guidance around selection, administration context and interpretation.
